 EP, Las Vegas, romcom… Lisa from Blackpink is everywhere in 2026
 Singer, lead rapper and dancer of the K-pop group Blackpink, Lisa is taking on a growing number of projects. With a new EP, a Las Vegas residency and two acting projects, including a Korean action thriller and a romantic comedy, the star with 105 million Instagram followers is more ambitious than ever.
 By Ambra Flora ,  
 and Violaine Schütz . 
 -->
 Voir cette publication sur Instagram Une publication partagée par LISA (@lalalalisa_m) 
 2026 is a major year for singer Lisa , who is carving a path for herself beyond the K-pop group Blackpink . On October 23rd, 2026, she will unveil Press Play , a six-track EP released by LLOUD , Lisa’s company founded in partnership with RCA Records . The project comes after Alter Ego (2025), her debut solo album. With her new release, the singer takes a more personal approach, connecting her Thai roots to her journey as a global superstar.
 The first single to be unveiled, SaWaDiKa , places Thai language and culture at the heart of her musical identity. The music video, shot in Bangkok, marks a symbolic return to Lisa’s home country. The Thai singer, rapper and dancer is opening a new chapter in her career, which will continue with a Las Vegas residency set to take her pop stardom to a whole new level.
 Lisa – SaWaDiKa (2026). 
 An EP and a Las Vegas residency: Lisa’s new ambitious projects
 In November 2026, Lisa will take over the Colosseum at Caesars Palace with Viva La Lisa , her very first series of shows in Las Vegas. Six performances are scheduled on November 12th, 13th, 14th, 27th, 28th and 29th, 2026. After the announcement of the first four dates, which sold out in less than ten minutes, two additional nights were added. This success once again demonstrates the extent of her international popularity.
 With this show, the artist becomes the first K-pop star to secure a residency in the entertainment capital of the world. Las Vegas will give her the opportunity to create a spectacular stage production. Following her solo performances at Coachella in 2025 and her appearances on some of the world’s biggest stages, Lisa is gradually establishing her own artistic identity beyond Blackpink, while continuing to work with the band.
 The cover of the EP Press Play (2026) by Lisa. 
 After The White Lotus , Lisa sets her sights on the seventh art
 Another major venture? Pranpriya Manobal , aka Lisa, is taking up space on television and cinema. Other members of the South Korean girl band Blackpink have previously starred on screen, like Jennie in The Idol and Jisoo in several K-dramas. After a widely acclaimed debut role in season 3 of The White Lotus in 2025, in which she played Mook, a mysterious wellness coach, the Thai idol is continuing to build on her success. She is set to star in a Korean action thriller and a romantic comedy, both expected to be released on Netflix.
 At 29, Lisa is returning to the country that first brought her into the public eye, South Korea, with an action film titled Extraction: Tygo . The plot remains under wraps for now, but its producers envision it as a spin-off of the American franchise Extraction , directed by Sam Hargrave and starring Chris Hemsworth . Lisa will star alongside Ma Dong-seok , a major figure in Korean action cinema ( The Roundup ), and Lee Jin-wook ( Squid Game ). The film will be directed by Lee Sang-yong ( The Roundup ) and co-produced by brothers Anthony and Joe Russo .
 Lisa from Blackpink in New York on March 6th, 2025. © TheStewartofNY/Getty Images for ABA via Gettey Images. 
 A romantic comedy in the works
 In addition to these multiple projects, Lisa , aka Lalisa Manobal , is also expected to take the lead role in a romantic comedy, whose title and plot remain unknown. Katie Silberman , the screenwriter best known for her work on Set It Up (2018), Booksmart (2019) and Don’t Worry Darling (2022), will pen the script.
 The official synopsis has yet to be unveiled. According to Deadline , the executive producer of The White Lotus , David Bernad , reportedly developed the concept with Lisa while filming the third season of the hit show. The two are said to have bonded over their shared admiration for Notting Hill , the cult 1999 romcom starring Julia Roberts and Hugh Grant , which apparently inspired the idea for this new project.
 Press Play by Lisa, coming out on October 23rd, 2026. 
 Lee Sang-yong’s film Extraction: Tygo does not have a release date yet.
